notice: Designed operator scenarios; not real incident records, passing replay tests, or directly runtime-compatible v0.1 evidence fixtures. All examples use reserved example names and documentation IPs.
diagnosis_contract: Use existing four scoped statuses and at most two evidence-supported candidate domains. Missing optional evidence limits comparisons but does not erase valid target observations; use insufficient_evidence for a requested conclusion when its essential evidence is missing.

cases.title: DNS resolver or CDN steering
cases.user_input: Our users say https://shop.example is slow with resolver 192.0.2.53. Is DNS slow?
cases.competing_hypotheses: Slow resolver processing; resolver-dependent endpoint steering; server delay
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Query each permitted resolver for A/AAAA and time; compare normal and hostname-preserving pinned HTTPS to a common approved address.
cases.required_evidence: Resolver, transport, response code, TTL/answers, timings, actual IP, family, proxy, hostname, SNI and verification.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Same resolver and same IP in repeated near-time requests; healthy matched control.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report observed resolver response or request phase within matched conditions.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Different answers prove resolver CPU or DNS processing is slow.
cases.v0_1_support: DNS and curl partial; matched normal/pinned comparison exists for replay, but live pinned collection and comparison are missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Use a local authoritative DNS and HTTPS server with two resolver responses; independently delay DNS or HTTP and assert correct scoped output.

cases.title: DNSSEC and extended errors
cases.user_input: https://secure.example sometimes fails to resolve; can you check the resolver?
cases.competing_hypotheses: Validation failure; unreachable authority; resolver or transport failure
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Query configured authorized resolver and capture status plus EDE if returned; compare same question at an approved independent resolver.
cases.required_evidence: Query type, transport, status, EDE code/text if present, time, resolver and responses.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Same resolver successfully resolves an approved control name; second resolver resolves the same name.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report SERVFAIL and returned EDE as resolver-provided evidence only.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: A missing EDE proves DNSSEC is healthy; EDE proves the exact failing server.
cases.v0_1_support: DNS partial; EDE and validated comparison missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Local DNS test server returns SERVFAIL with and without EDE; verify missingness and literal code retention.

cases.title: DNS UDP truncation
cases.user_input: The name files.example fails only on our office resolver.
cases.symptom: Name lookup fails on one transport
cases.competing_hypotheses: Truncated UDP without TCP fallback; resolver failure; filtering
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Compare bounded explicit UDP and TCP queries for the same name, record TC flag and responses.
cases.required_evidence: Resolver, query, transport, response flags, answer and timeout.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Small response on the same resolver succeeds over both transports.
cases.allowed_conclusion: A transport-specific response difference is observed.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: A UDP timeout proves a firewall or a broken authoritative server.
cases.v0_1_support: DNS partial; transport fallback and TC evidence missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Local DNS server returns TC on UDP and answer on TCP, plus an unrelated timeout; verify distinctions.

cases.title: IPv6 fallback
cases.user_input: https://portal.example loads eventually but is slow on dual-stack laptops.
cases.competing_hypotheses: IPv6 connectivity degradation; both families slow; server delay
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Repeat normal and separately forced IPv4 and IPv6 HTTPS with identical hostname and verified TLS.
cases.required_evidence: Actual address/family, connection and request results, timings, window and proxy.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Repeat both families to approved control and repeat original.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report observed family-specific difference and incomplete fallback visibility.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: A forced IPv6 failure proves a routing leak or normal client fallback.
cases.v0_1_support: curl partial; controlled family comparison missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Local dual-stack listener delays or rejects IPv6 only; verify force modes and normal address records.

cases.title: Split VPN and HTTP 403
cases.user_input: https://intranet.example returns 403 while I am on the VPN, but works off VPN.
cases.symptom: HTTP authorization failure correlated with VPN
cases.competing_hypotheses: Different egress or policy; DNS steering; expired credentials
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Compare authorized on/off VPN observations without changing the VPN; record family, IP, proxy, status and server identity.
cases.required_evidence: Redacted URL, response status, actual address/family, route context, timing and comparable identity.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Same account and request on original path after comparison; other permitted service on each path.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report a 403 scoped to observed context.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Identify a firewall rule or instruct credential changes based only on 403.
cases.v0_1_support: HTTP and context partial; cross-context comparison missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Use local endpoints returning 403 based on controlled source/context; verify that status stays an application observation.

cases.title: HTTPS identity
cases.user_input: https://billing.example says certificate verification failed after an address change.
cases.competing_hypotheses: Wrong certificate or SNI; trust chain problem; interception
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Perform verified normal HTTPS and hostname-preserving pinned comparison to approved address; capture error and negotiated metadata where available.
cases.required_evidence: Hostname, SNI, verified certificate result, IP, proxy, ALPN, TLS error and time.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Verified request to known-good authorized endpoint; original request repeated.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report certificate verification failure for that connection.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Disable verification or assert certificate ownership from error alone.
cases.v0_1_support: curl TLS partial; matched normal/pinned comparison exists for replay, but live pinned collection and comparison are missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Use local CA and virtual-host server with matching and mismatching certificates; assert verification remains enabled.

cases.title: Intermediate hop silence
cases.user_input: A trace to api.example shows a hop with missing replies. Is that router dropping traffic?
cases.competing_hypotheses: ICMP rate limiting; forwarding loss; ECMP
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Run one finite numeric path report and compare endpoint responses and HTTPS in same window.
cases.required_evidence: Probe type, cycles, hop response counts, destination responses, business result and time.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Later hops and endpoint respond while the business request succeeds.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report missing hop responses and downstream observations.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Blame router or calculate forwarded packet loss from hop reply loss.
cases.v0_1_support: Ping and HTTP partial; path adapter missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Replay versioned path samples with missing middle-hop replies and normal destination; assert no router blame.

cases.title: Path variation and ECMP
cases.user_input: The hops to app.example change on each trace. Is the route flapping?
cases.competing_hypotheses: ECMP per-flow variation; actual route change; asymmetric replies
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Compare repeated bounded flow-aware reports with fixed tuple where supported, timestamps and destination outcomes.
cases.required_evidence: Protocol, ports/strategy, hop hosts, family, counts and timestamps.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Repeated fixed-flow traces and stable endpoint results.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report observed path variation and method.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Infer routing instability or geographical location from hop variation alone.
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Replay flow-aware multi-address samples and changed-flow samples; preserve both without asserting flapping.

cases.title: PMTU and tunnel
cases.user_input: Small requests to upload.example work through the tunnel, but larger uploads stall.
cases.competing_hypotheses: PMTU black hole; upload server limit; tunnel congestion
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Record tunnel/interface context; compare authorized small and size-sensitive bounded probes and PMTU discovery.
cases.required_evidence: Probe protocol and sizes, family, PMTU feedback, endpoint result, tunnel context, time.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Same small request succeeds and an approved alternate path is measured.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report size-dependent observations and PMTU as a candidate if supported.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Prove a black hole from silence or change MTU automatically.
cases.v0_1_support: Small HTTP partial; PMTU and size comparison missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Local isolated tunnel with known MTU and filtered ICMP, followed by restored feedback; verify recovery and no automatic mutation.

cases.title: HTTP/3 and TCP
cases.user_input: video.example works in a browser sometimes but fails when HTTP/3 is used.
cases.competing_hypotheses: UDP/QUIC filtering; HTTP/3 service failure; TCP path difference
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: If client supports it, compare bounded HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 requests to the same hostname and record actual negotiation and result.
cases.required_evidence: Requested and negotiated version, address/family, status, error, proxy and timing.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Repeat HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 on same approved alternative path.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report protocol-specific behavior where negotiation is proven.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Claim UDP firewall rule or HTTP/3 support merely from a fallback success.
cases.v0_1_support: HTTP and negotiated http_version metadata exist; controlled HTTP/3 versus HTTP/2 selection and comparison are missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Local HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 services with UDP blocked in an isolated network; verify fallback is distinguished from HTTP/3 success.

cases.title: Latency under load
cases.user_input: Calls to voice.example become choppy while someone uploads.
cases.competing_hypotheses: Queueing; host CPU contention; remote service issue
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: With explicit test authorization, compare repeated idle, bounded load and recovery windows with throughput and latency.
cases.required_evidence: Load direction/rate, interval samples, latency, endpoints, CPU/context and recovery.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Repeated idle and post-load windows and an unloaded control.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report repeatable load-associated latency within tested scope.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Declare bufferbloat or name a queue without independent evidence.
cases.v0_1_support: Finite ping partial; load and repeated windows missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Isolated test server and controlled bottleneck; validate injection independently, remove load, and verify recovery.

cases.title: Retransmission or capture artifact
cases.user_input: This capture of api.example shows TCP retransmissions. Where is the loss?
cases.competing_hypotheses: Actual retransmission; reordering; capture drops or midstream capture
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Analyze offline capture with frame references and capture metadata; compare opposite-end capture if available.
cases.required_evidence: Capture hash, frame IDs, stream, timing, flags, visibility, drops and truncation.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Independent complete capture covering same flow and interval.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report suspected retransmission or missing captured segments with limits.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Compute path loss or blame a hop based on one capture.
cases.v0_1_support: Offline PCAP discovers fields and retains capture hash, timestamps, frame/stream metadata and expert flags in hashed raw events, plus summary and coverage; structured per-stream timeline, finding-to-frame links, richer capture-origin/drop metadata and opposite-end correlation are missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Use locally generated captures with known reorder, dropped capture frames and actual retransmission; assert distinct limitations.

cases.title: TCP zero window
cases.user_input: The transfer from db.example pauses even though the route looks fine.
cases.symptom: Transfer stalls with possible zero window
cases.competing_hypotheses: Receiver application pressure; loss or path interruption
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Inspect offline TCP window and optional scoped socket details in a matching time window.
cases.required_evidence: Frame references, direction, advertised window, connection identity, timestamps and socket visibility.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Matched healthy transfer and receiver window reopening.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report observed receiver-advertised zero window for the flow.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Name the process or blame the network without endpoint evidence.
cases.v0_1_support: Offline PCAP retains and counts zero-window flags where supported; detailed advertised-window and socket correlation are missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Local receiver deliberately stops reading then resumes; verify zero-window observation and scope.

cases.title: Interface counters
cases.user_input: The connection to backup.example drops during backups. Are there interface errors?
cases.competing_hypotheses: NIC errors; unrelated shared traffic; remote path failure
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Read relevant route/interface and two timestamped snapshots of read-only interface and driver counters.
cases.required_evidence: Interface identity, counter names, units, driver, timestamps, values and reset/missing state.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Same interface idle interval and known-good control flow.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report counter deltas on the interface during the window.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Attribute shared counters to one flow or equate every driver counter with drops.
cases.v0_1_support: Read-only context partial; typed deltas missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Use a controlled virtual interface with known counter changes and reset; test missing/driver-specific counters.

cases.title: External vantage
cases.user_input: Is service.example unreachable only from our network?
cases.competing_hypotheses: Local path issue; wider provider outage; service selection
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: After explicit disclosure approval, compare bounded local observation with selected external probes and record public measurement identifiers.
cases.required_evidence: Public target, probe location/ASN/ID, time, protocol, actual address and completion.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: A known permitted control from the same probes and repeated local target.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Report observed differences among named vantage points.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Claim global outage or local blame from a few nonrepresentative probes.
cases.v0_1_support: Local HTTP partial; external vantage missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Use a mocked API and predefined probe outputs including unavailable/partial probes; verify disclosure and cost limits.

cases.title: Intermittent normal window
cases.user_input: Users say dashboard.example failed yesterday, but it works now. Is it fixed?
cases.competing_hypotheses: Recovered transient failure; not reproduced; insufficient coverage
cases.proposed_tool_sequence: Run bounded normal target checks and approved control; record time and missing capabilities.
cases.required_evidence: Window, sample counts, HTTP status, actual endpoint and failed/unavailable measurements.
cases.negative_controls_falsifiers: Known-good control and repeated original during available window.
cases.allowed_conclusion: A valid short target success supports not_reproduced; the same success with optional DNS, ping or control absent still supports not_reproduced with limitations. Missing required target observations or evidence essential to a specifically requested comparison supports insufficient_evidence for that requested conclusion.
cases.prohibited_overclaims: Claim permanent health, deny historical fault or infer a root cause.
cases.v0_1_support: Existing scoped states and HTTP partial; longer observation missing
cases.proposed_local_test_plan: Check three cases: valid short target success yields not_reproduced; the same success with optional DNS, ping or control absent remains not_reproduced with limitations; missing required target observation or evidence essential to a specifically requested comparison yields insufficient_evidence for that requested conclusion.
